## How to run it

api (DeepInfra) · $0.090/M blended · $0.06 in / $0.18 out per 1M tokens · [deepinfra.com ↗](https://deepinfra.com/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash)

[price source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json) · USD per 1M text tokens. DeepInfra standard synchronous API; model inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash. Uncached input; output includes generated reasoning where billed. Provider input limit 131,072 tokens; quantization not specified in the provider record. Batch, cache storage, tools and other modalities excluded.

[context specification source](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/c19ce71bcdad234ca87a7af10cee45375ce811a8/model_prices_and_context_window.json) · DeepInfra API maximum input tokens from exact catalogue record deepinfra/inclusionAI/Ling-3.0-flash; not the legacy max\_tokens field.
